meta.title: Annual Report 2025
meta.description: Discover some of Revolut's milestones for 2025 and beyond in our latest Annual Report.

content.caption: 2025 Annual Report
content.title: Raising the banking standard
content.description: In 2025, a record number of personal and business customers put their trust in us, as we achieved our highest valuation yet. And now, as a bank in the UK, we'll continue to simplify all things money.

items.title: Another year of breaking barriers
items.description: 2025 saw sustainable growth, new banking licenses, and record profitability.
items.caption: Overview

items.title: More people choose us as their main account
items.description: Our total number of retail customers continued to grow. We saw a 45% year-on-year increase of people choosing us as their primary bank.
items.caption: Customer growth

items.title: Profitability that’s built to last
items.description: Our business model generates diverse and balanced profits across personal and business finances, and it continues to grow. Our GBP profit-before-tax grew by 57%, year-on-year.
items.caption: Profitability

content.title: On the road to 100 million customers, globally
content.description: As of today, 80+ million retail customers are choosing Revolut worldwide. And with 1 million new customers now joining every 17 days,¹ we’re on our way to reaching 100 million customers by mid-2027.
content.footnote: ¹Based on data from the end of 2025.

content.title: A new milestone in customer balances
content.description: With a 66% increase in total balances, they grew at a higher rate than our customer base. This reflects a deepening trust from those who already call Revolut home.

content.title: The future of global banking
content.description: We advanced our mission to launch as a bank in 100 countries, securing key banking and payment authorisations in 2025. In 2026, we received our UK banking license and applied for our US banking charter.

content.title: More products, more momentum
content.description: Top products are growing. New launches are making waves. People are asking more from their money.
content.footnote: All product availability depends on customer’s country of residence. T&Cs apply.

items.title: 42% growth in paid plans, including expansion to 3 new markets

image.alt: 42% growth in paid plans, including expansion to 3 new markets

items.title: Reduced customer support resolution times by 40%

image.alt: Reduced customer support resolution times by 40%

items.title: Revolut ATMs, starting in Spain
items.description: We redefined the ATM in 2025, giving customers in Spain the option to withdraw cash or collect a card, for free. More countries coming soon.
items.caption: ATMs

items.title: Revolut Mobile is calling
items.description: Revolut Mobile is live in Poland and the UK, offering unlimited data, calls, and texts at home, plus global roaming. Our eSIMs keep people connected worldwide.²
items.caption: Mobile

items.title: Mortgages land in Lithuania
items.description: Streamlined applications. No issuance fees. Dedicated support. We’ve modernised mortgages, so your next home can start here.
items.caption: Mortgages

items.title: Guarding money on-the-go
items.description: Stay ahead of evolving fraud tactics with our new feature, Street Mode, which allows you to activate delays on larger transfers outside trusted locations, and stay in control.
items.caption: Street Mode

items.title: Money freedom for 16 & 17s
items.description: In the UK, teens over 16 can now join the main Revolut app, for more independence without the parental permissions. Meanwhile, kids aged 5 to 15 continue to learn healthy money habits in the parent-supervised Kids & Teens app.
items.caption: Kids & Teens

items.title: Revolut Pay x Booking.com
items.description: We’ve brought our secure, one-click checkout to Booking.com. The 4.8 million Revolut customers using Revolut Pay can make flexible, fast bookings, while they earn and redeem RevPoints.
items.caption: Revolut Pay

items.title: Know when it’s us calling
items.description: We’re continuing to innovate to protect our customers. Like with our new in-app banner that lets you confirm if a call is from us, and stop fraudsters in their tracks. If the call is fake, the warning is real.
items.caption: Safe calling

content.title: 750K+ companies using Revolut Business
content.description: In 2025, Revolut Business proved itself as one of the largest business finance players, with 30,000 companies joining every month, including Booking.com.

content.title: Business customers grew by 33%
content.description: A record number of companies downloaded and adopted Revolut Business driven by key launches like Titan, our top-tier account offering.

content.title: Driving the Dream Team
content.description: From opening new offices to growing our grad programme, we continued to find new ways to help our remote-first teams get it done, making us a certified great place to work in 14 countries.

items.title: A great place to work
items.description: We’re certified as a great place to work in the UK, India, Poland, Lithuania, Romania, Hungary, Spain, Portugal, and 6 other countries.

items.title: New global offices
items.description: We opened our global HQ in London and Western Europe HQ in Paris. New offices in Madrid and Barcelona are next.

items.title: 1.7M job applications
items.description: Intern and grad programmes doubled in size, and in 2025 we attracted more top talent than ever.

content.title: A message from our founders
content.description:
2025 was a milestone year as we celebrated our tenth anniversary and delivered our strongest performance to date. 

We are proud that more people than ever now choose Revolut as their primary account to manage every part of their finances. This momentum has cemented our status as Europe’s most valuable private technology company.

We thank our employees, investors, and customers for being part of this journey as we work toward our next milestone of serving 100 million people globally. A decade in, we remain as ambitious as ever — we are still just getting started.

— Nik & Vlad

Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and Prudential Regulation Authority (Financial Services Register No. 981170).

Revolut Ltd is registered in England and Wales (No. 08804411), is authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority to offer e-money and payment services under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011 (FRN: 900562), and is registered with the Financial Conduct Authority to offer cryptocurrency services under the Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017. Commodities services are provided by Revolut Ltd and are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Investment services are provided by Revolut Trading Ltd (No. 11567840), which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN: 933846).

The registered address of Revolut Ltd, Revolut Travel Ltd, and Revolut Trading Ltd is at 30 South Colonnade, London, United Kingdom, E14 5HX. You can read more about our terms and policies here.
